cases.title: Credential forwarded to an untrusted child process
cases.description: Regression for the P0 credential-isolation defect that Verifier V1 left inconclusive.

finding.title: Sensitive credential propagated to child process environment
finding.description: A host credential crosses an explicitly untrusted child-process boundary.
finding.suggestion: Construct the child environment from an allowlist that excludes host credentials.

cases.title: User input concatenated into a SQL query
cases.description: A SQL injection sink must be surfaced as a blocking security finding.

finding.title: SQL query constructed from untrusted input
finding.description: Request data is concatenated into a database query.
finding.suggestion: Use a parameterized query and bind user-controlled values.

cases.title: Request value reaches a shell command
cases.description: Command construction from untrusted request data must block the merge gate.

finding.title: Subprocess launched with untrusted command input
finding.description: A request parameter controls the command passed to a child process.
finding.suggestion: Replace shell construction with a fixed executable and validated arguments.

cases.title: Untrusted path escapes the configured workspace
cases.description: A variable file path without a root-boundary check is a blocking security defect.

finding.title: Potential file inclusion outside artifact root
finding.description: The opened path can be influenced by an external artifact name.
finding.suggestion: Resolve symlinks and prove the final path remains under the trusted root.

cases.title: Production credential committed in source
cases.description: A hardcoded credential must be treated as P0 even when it appears in configuration code.

finding.title: Hardcoded production credential detected
finding.description: Source code contains a value shaped like a production access token.
finding.suggestion: Remove the value, rotate the credential, and load it from the secret store.

cases.title: TLS certificate verification disabled
cases.description: Disabling server identity verification creates a blocking man-in-the-middle risk.

finding.title: TLS certificate verification is disabled
finding.description: The transport accepts certificates without validating server identity.
finding.suggestion: Enable certificate verification and configure a trusted root set.

cases.title: Weak hash used for password material
cases.description: Password-derived data must not use a collision-prone hash primitive.

finding.title: Weak cryptographic primitive used for password hashing
finding.description: The implementation hashes password material with a weak general-purpose digest.
finding.suggestion: Use a password KDF such as Argon2id with an application-specific work factor.

cases.title: Administrative action bypasses authorization
cases.description: Cross-function reasoning must detect a privileged handler that omits the shared authorization guard.

finding.title: Administrative delete path bypasses authorization guard
finding.description: The new handler reaches a privileged mutation without calling the repository authorization guard.
finding.suggestion: Apply the shared authorization middleware and add a negative-permission test.

cases.title: Authentication token written to logs
cases.description: A secret flowing into structured logs must be detected across helper calls.

finding.title: Authentication token exposed through request logging
finding.description: A bearer token is forwarded to a logging helper without redaction.
finding.suggestion: Log a stable non-secret identifier and redact credential fields at the boundary.

cases.title: Changed regression test fails
cases.description: Regression for deterministic test failure normalization and P1 merge blocking.

finding.title: Changed regression test failed
finding.description: A test covering the modified behavior fails deterministically.
finding.suggestion: Fix the regression and keep the failing case as a permanent test.

cases.title: Optional result dereferenced without a guard
cases.description: Repository context shows that a lookup can return nil before the new dereference.

finding.title: Optional cache entry can be dereferenced when absent
finding.description: The changed code dereferences a lookup result on the documented miss path.
finding.suggestion: Handle the miss before reading fields and add an empty-cache regression test.

cases.title: Map mutation races across worker goroutines
cases.description: A shared map is written from parallel workers without synchronization.

finding.title: Concurrent workers mutate an unprotected map
finding.description: Two worker paths write the same map without a mutex or ownership boundary.
finding.suggestion: Serialize ownership or guard all accesses with the same synchronization primitive.

cases.title: Check-then-act sequence permits duplicate execution
cases.description: Two requests can observe the same pending state and both start the job.

finding.title: Non-atomic job transition allows duplicate execution
finding.description: State validation and transition are separate operations without a compare-and-swap guard.
finding.suggestion: Use an atomic transition or transaction with an expected-state predicate.

cases.title: Transaction error path commits partial state
cases.description: A failed secondary write returns without rolling back the transaction.

finding.title: Failed order update leaves a partial transaction
finding.description: The new error return bypasses the rollback path after the first mutation.
finding.suggestion: Defer rollback immediately after begin and commit only after all writes succeed.

cases.title: Worker goroutine ignores cancellation
cases.description: A retry loop can outlive the request because it never selects on context cancellation.

finding.title: Retry goroutine can survive request cancellation
finding.description: The loop waits only on a timer and never observes the parent context.
finding.suggestion: Select on the retry timer and context cancellation on every iteration.

cases.title: HTTP response body is not closed
cases.description: An early return after a successful request leaks the response body and connection.

finding.title: HTTP response body is not closed
finding.description: The successful response path returns without closing the body.
finding.suggestion: Defer response body closure immediately after checking the request error.

cases.title: Integer overflow bypasses quota enforcement
cases.description: Multiplication before a quota comparison can wrap and admit an oversized request.

finding.title: Overflow can bypass request quota validation
finding.description: The product is computed before validating operands against the maximum quota.
finding.suggestion: Validate operands before multiplication or use checked arithmetic.

cases.title: Mutation path omits cache invalidation
cases.description: Repository context links the updated write path to a read-through cache that remains stale.

finding.title: Profile update leaves the read cache stale
finding.description: The new mutation commits successfully but omits the invalidation used by sibling update paths.
finding.suggestion: Invalidate the profile cache after commit and add a write-then-read regression test.

cases.title: File close error is ignored
cases.description: A durability-relevant close failure should remain visible without blocking a P1 gate.

finding.title: Output file close error is discarded
finding.description: The writer reports success even if the final close operation fails.
finding.suggestion: Return or join the close error for durability-sensitive output.

cases.title: Request count controls an unbounded allocation
cases.description: A potentially large allocation is P2 under the default policy and should not block merging.

finding.title: Batch size can trigger an unbounded allocation
finding.description: The new slice capacity is copied directly from a request-controlled count.
finding.suggestion: Apply a documented maximum before allocating the batch buffer.

cases.title: Database call drops request cancellation
cases.description: Using a background context reduces cancellation correctness but remains non-blocking at P2.

finding.title: Database query ignores request cancellation
finding.description: The changed call replaces the request context with a background context.
finding.suggestion: Propagate the caller context to the database operation.

cases.title: Nested scan introduces quadratic work
cases.description: A nested lookup over the same collection should be reported as a non-blocking performance risk.

finding.title: Nested matching loop scales quadratically
finding.description: Every changed symbol scans the full repository symbol list.
finding.suggestion: Build an index keyed by symbol identity before matching.

cases.title: Authorization change lacks a negative test
cases.description: A missing denial-path test is tracked as P2 and must remain visible without blocking.

finding.title: Authorization branch has no denial-path regression test
finding.description: The changed allow condition is exercised only by positive tests.
finding.suggestion: Add a test proving an unprivileged principal remains denied.

cases.title: Timing assertion relies on a fixed sleep
cases.description: A fixed sleep creates a flaky regression test but is non-blocking under the P1 gate.

finding.title: Fixed sleep makes the worker test timing-dependent
finding.description: The test assumes completion within an arbitrary wall-clock delay.
finding.suggestion: Synchronize on an observable event with a bounded timeout.

cases.title: New helper is unreachable
cases.description: An unused helper is a P3 maintainability issue and should not block the PR.

finding.title: New helper is never used
finding.description: The added private helper has no call sites.
finding.suggestion: Remove the helper or integrate it into the intended path.

cases.title: Conditional branches perform identical work
cases.description: Duplicated branches add maintenance cost but remain a P3 notice.

finding.title: Conditional branches contain duplicate logic
finding.description: Both sides assign the same normalized configuration value.
finding.suggestion: Collapse the branches into a single assignment.

cases.title: Public option is missing documentation
cases.description: A newly exported configuration option without documentation is a non-blocking P3 issue.

finding.title: Exported gate option lacks behavioral documentation
finding.description: The new public option changes merge behavior but has no contract comment.
finding.suggestion: Document defaults, accepted values, and failure semantics.

cases.title: Possible authorization boundary bypass
cases.description: A P0 hypothesis without independent evidence must remain visible and block pending review.

hypothesis.title: Restore endpoint may bypass tenant authorization
hypothesis.reason: The source boundary is valid, but available static and semantic evidence cannot prove the tenant guard executes.

cases.title: Possible credential exfiltration through plugin metadata
cases.description: An unresolved P0 secret-flow hypothesis exercises the separate Needs Review gate.

hypothesis.title: Plugin metadata may expose a host credential
hypothesis.reason: The candidate reaches a serialization helper, but the repository snapshot cannot establish whether redaction occurs at runtime.

cases.title: Possible state corruption under retry
cases.description: An unresolved P1 hypothesis remains visible but does not cross the default P0 Needs Review threshold.

hypothesis.title: Retry may apply the same transition twice
hypothesis.reason: The transition appears non-idempotent, but the external storage contract is not available in repository evidence.

cases.title: Possible channel liveness issue
cases.description: A P2 concurrency hypothesis tests non-blocking human-review presentation.

hypothesis.title: Fan-out sender may wait forever after cancellation
hypothesis.reason: The send is potentially blocking, but buffer ownership and shutdown ordering cannot be confirmed statically.

cases.title: Possible backward-compatibility change
cases.description: A P3 compatibility hypothesis should be visible without affecting the default merge decision.

hypothesis.title: Response field rename may break older clients
hypothesis.reason: Repository references were updated, but external consumer compatibility cannot be established from local evidence.

cases.title: Reasoning Agent degradation does not block deterministic evidence
cases.description: Regression for the PR #9 failure where Agent partial incorrectly contaminated Verifier status and blocked a P2-only review.

cases.title: Incomplete deterministic analysis fails closed
cases.description: A partial analyzer run must block even when no P0/P1 finding was produced.

cases.title: Incomplete Verifier evidence fails closed
cases.description: A real semantic verification failure must not be waived as optional Agent degradation.

cases.title: Documentation-only change
cases.description: Regression proving a documentation-only PR remains clean and unblocked.

cases.title: Parameterized SQL query
cases.description: User input is bound as a parameter and must not trigger an injection finding.

cases.title: Fixed executable with validated arguments
cases.description: A child process launched from a fixed allowlist is a negative command-injection control.

cases.title: File access constrained beneath a trusted root
cases.description: Resolved-path containment and symlink rejection form a clean path-access control.

cases.title: Secret redacted before structured logging
cases.description: A logging helper receives only a stable token fingerprint, not the original credential.

cases.title: TLS verification with a minimum protocol version
cases.description: A hardened TLS configuration is the negative control for transport-security findings.

cases.title: Shared map access protected by one mutex
cases.description: All read and write paths use the same lock and should not produce a race hypothesis.

cases.title: Request context propagated with a bounded timeout
cases.description: The downstream operation preserves cancellation while adding a local deadline.

cases.title: Transaction rollback is deferred immediately
cases.description: All error paths roll back and only the successful path commits.

cases.title: Quota arithmetic validates operands before multiplication
cases.description: Bounds are checked before arithmetic, preventing overflow and quota bypass.

cases.title: Write and close errors are propagated
cases.description: A joined error preserves both the write failure and final close failure.

cases.title: Worker test synchronizes on an observable event
cases.description: The test uses an event and bounded timeout instead of an arbitrary sleep.

cases.title: Internal configuration field rename
cases.description: All repository references and serialized names remain compatible after an internal rename.

cases.title: Dependency checksum-only update
cases.description: A checksum refresh without executable source changes should remain clean.

cases.title: Generated API documentation refresh
cases.description: A generated documentation artifact with no runtime changes must not be falsely blocked.
